text: Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light.
author: Helen Keller

text: In the sweetness of friendship let there be laughter, and sharing of pleasures. For in the dew of little things the heart finds its morning and is refreshed.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: One of the most beautiful qualities of true friendship is to understand and to be understood.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

text: There is nothing on this earth more to be prized than true friendship.
author: Thomas Aquinas

text: Lovers have a right to betray you... friends don't.
author: Judy Holliday

text: Remember that the most valuable antiques are dear old friends.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

text: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things that give value to survival.
author: C. S. Lewis

text: A friend is someone who gives you total freedom to be yourself.
author: Jim Morrison

text: There is a magnet in your heart that will attract true friends. That magnet is unselfishness, thinking of others first; when you learn to live for others, they will live for you.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: The language of friendship is not words but meanings.
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: My best friend is the one who brings out the best in me.
author: Henry Ford

text: It is more shameful to distrust our friends than to be deceived by them.
author: Confucius

text: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by the doubling of our joy and the dividing of our grief.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

text: Friendship... is not something you learn in school. But if you haven't learned the meaning of friendship, you really haven't learned anything.
author: Muhammad Ali

text: Be slow to fall into friendship; but when thou art in, continue firm and constant.
author: Socrates

text: A man's friendships are one of the best measures of his worth.
author: Charles Darwin

text: The friend who can be silent with us in a moment of despair or confusion, who can stay with us in an hour of grief and bereavement, who can tolerate not knowing... not healing, not curing... that is a friend who cares.
author: Henri Nouwen

text: A friend to all is a friend to none.
author: Aristotle

text: Friendship needs no words - it is solitude delivered from the anguish of loneliness.
author: Dag Hammarskjold

text: Of all possessions a friend is the most precious.
author: Herodotus

text: When you choose your friends, don't be short-changed by choosing personality over character.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

text: It's the friends you can call up at 4 a.m. that matter.
author: Marlene Dietrich

text: A friend is what the heart needs all the time.
author: Henry Van Dyke

text: An insincere and evil friend is more to be feared than a wild beast; a wild beast may wound your body, but an evil friend will wound your mind.
author: Unknown

text: Things are never quite as scary when you've got a best friend.
author: Bill Watterson

text: Two persons cannot long be friends if they cannot forgive each other's little failings.
author: Jean de la Bruyere

text: Let us be grateful to people who make us happy, they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
author: Marcel Proust

text: A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
author: Walter Winchell

text: There are no strangers here; Only friends you haven't yet met.
author: William Butler Yeats

text: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Lots of people want to ride with you in the limo, but what you want is someone who will take the bus with you when the limo breaks down.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: I cannot even imagine where I would be today were it not for that handful of friends who have given me a heart full of joy. Let's face it, friends make life a lot more fun.
author: Charles R. Swindoll

text: The greatest gift of life is friendship, and I have received it.
author: Hubert H. Humphrey

text: Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
author: Euripides

text: Some people go to priests; others to poetry; I to my friends.
author: Virginia Woolf

text: A single rose can be my garden... a single friend, my world.
author: Leo Buscaglia

text: My friends are my estate.
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Friends are the siblings God never gave us.
author: Mencius

text: I don't need a friend who changes when I change and who nods when I nod; my shadow does that much better.
author: Plutarch

text: As iron sharpens iron, so a friend sharpens a friend.
author: King Solomon

text: There is no friend like an old friend who has shared our morning days, no greeting like his welcome, no homage like his praise.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr.

text: I have learned that to be with those I like is enough.
author: Walt Whitman

text: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it's all over.
author: Octavia E. Butler

text: It takes a long time to grow an old friend.
author: John Leonard

text: A friend is a gift you give yourself.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

text: Be courteous to all, but intimate with few, and let those few be well tried before you give them your confidence.
author: George Washington

text: I have friends in overalls whose friendship I would not swap for the favor of the kings of the world.
author: Thomas A. Edison

text: A true friend is someone who is there for you when he'd rather be anywhere else.
author: Len Wein

text: Friendship … is born at the moment when one man says to another, 'What! You too? I thought that no one but myself…'
author: C.S. Lewis

text: Words are easy, like the wind; faithful friends are hard to find.
author: William Shakespeare

text: Growing apart doesn't change the fact that for a long time we grew side by side; our roots will always be tangled. I'm glad for that.
author: Ally Condie

text: Courage. Kindness. Friendship. Character. These are the qualities that define us as human beings, and propel us, on occasion, to greatness.
author: R.J. Palacio

text: Friendship is everything. Friendship is more than talent. It is more than the government. It is almost the equal of family.
author: Mario Puzo

text: Friendships take minutes to make, moments to break, years to repair.
author: Pierce Brown

text: A real friend isn't capable of feeling sorry for you.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: Without friends, no one would want to live, even if he had all other goods.
author: Aristotle

text: Friends ask you questions; enemies question you.
author: Criss Jami

text: If you have but one friend, make sure you choose her well.
author: Muriel Barbery

text: There is nothing I would not do for those who are really my friends. I have no notion of loving people by halves, it is not my nature.
author: Jane Austen

text: Never leave a friend behind. Friends are all we have to get us through this life—and they are the only things from this world that we could hope to see in the next.
author: Dean Koontz

text: I got you to look after me, and you got me to look after you, and that's why.
author: John Steinbeck

text: If you care about somebody, you should want them to be happy. Even if you wind up being left out.
author: Stephen Chbosky
source: The Perks of Being a Wallflower

text: Friendship is always a sweet responsibility, never an opportunity.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: One friend with whom you have a lot in common is better than three with whom you struggle to find things to talk about.
author: Mindy Kaling
source: Is Everyone Hanging Out Without Me?

text: New friends can often have a better time together than old friends.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

text: A doubtful friend is worse than a certain enemy. Let a man be one thing or the other, and we then know how to meet him.
author: Aesop

text: It's all very well to tell us to forgive our enemies; our enemies can never hurt us very much. But oh, what about forgiving our friends?
author: Willa Cather

text: A snowball in the face is surely the perfect beginning to a lasting friendship.
author: Markus Zusak

text: My old grandmother always used to say, summer friends will melt away like summer snows, but winter friends are friends forever.
author: George R.R. Martin

text: It's not love or anything, but I think I like you, too.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

text: Cutting people out of your life is easy, keeping them in is hard.
author: Walter Dean Myers

text: You had to know a person well to make them laugh like that.
author: Cassandra Clare

text: You only really fall apart in front of the people you know can piece you back together.
author: Sarah Dessen

text: True friends show up when the world walks out.
author: Unknown

text: A good friend hears even what's left unsaid.
author: Unknown

text: Friendship is built in small, consistent moments.
author: Unknown

text: A true friend never counts favors.
author: Unknown

text: Real friends laugh until everything feels lighter.
author: Unknown

text: Distance doesn't dim a strong friendship.
author: Unknown

text: Trust turns acquaintances into true friends.
author: Unknown

text: Friendship means growing, even when it's hard.
author: Unknown

text: A friend believes in you, especially when you don't.
author: Unknown

text: One honest friend is worth a thousand polite smiles.
author: Unknown

text: Friendship thrives on effort, not just convenience.
author: Unknown

text: Loyal friends hold space for your messy days.
author: Unknown

text: Real friends celebrate your weirdness without flinching.
author: Unknown

text: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
author: Joan Powers

text: You can't stay in your corner of the Forest waiting for others to come to you. You have to go to them sometimes.
author: A.A. Milne

text: Why did you do all this for me?' he asked. 'I don't deserve it. I've never done anything for you.' 'You have been my friend,' replied Charlotte. 'That in itself is a tremendous thing.
author: E.B. White

text: It is more fun to talk with someone who doesn't use long, difficult words but rather short, easy words like 'What about lunch?'
author: A. A. Milne

text: A friend may be waiting behind a stranger's face.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Time doesn't take away from friendship, nor does separation.
author: Tennessee Williams

text: When friendships are real, they are not glass threads or frost work, but the solidest things we can know.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: An acquaintance merely enjoys your company, a fair-weather companion flatters when all is well, a true friend has your best interests at heart and the pluck to tell you what you need to hear.
author: E.A. Bucchianeri

text: Of all the means to ensure happiness throughout the whole life, by far the most important is the acquisition of friends.
author: Epicurus

text: The only true test of friendship is the time your friend spends on you.
author: John Marsden

text: Life is an awful, ugly place to not have a best friend.
author: Sarah Dessen

text: I am glad you are here with me. Here at the end of all things, Sam.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

text: Tis the privilege of friendship to talk nonsense, and to have her nonsense respected.
author: Charles Lamb
source: The Life, Letters and Writings of Charles Lamb Volume 3

text: There's not a word yet, for old friends who've just met.
author: Jim Henson
source: Favorite Songs From Jim Henson's Muppets

text: The pain of parting is nothing to the joy of meeting again.
author: Charles Dickens

text: There is no happiness like that of being loved by your fellow creatures, and feeling that your presence is an addition to their comfort.
author: Charlotte Brontë

text: Friendships between women, as any woman will tell you, are built of a thousand small kindnesses… swapped back and forth and over again.
author: Michelle Obama

text: Only a true best friend can protect you from your immortal enemies.
author: Richelle Mead

text: There are no faster or firmer friendships than those formed between people who love the same books.
author: Irving Stone

text: We always see our worst selves. Our most vulnerable selves. We need someone else to get close enough to tell us we're wrong. Someone we trust.
author: David Levithan
source: Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

text: It is not often that someone comes along who is a true friend and a good writer.
author: E.B. White

text: No friendship is an accident.
author: O. Henry

text: What do you most value in your friends? Their continued existence.
author: Christopher Hitchens

text: True friends are those who came into your life, saw the most negative part of you, but are not ready to leave you, no matter how contagious you are to them.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

text: To throw away an honest friend is, as it were, to throw your life away.
author: Sophocles

text: A real relationship is two-way.
author: Sophie Kinsella

text: Never hold resentments for the person who tells you what you need to hear; count them among your truest, most caring, and valuable friends.
author: Mike Norton

text: Loneliness does not come from having no people around you, but from being unable to communicate the things that seem important to you.
author: Carl Jung

text: The capacity for friendship is God's way of apologizing for our families.
author: Jay McInerney

text: In my next life, I want to be me, and meet you again.
author: Killua Zoldyck

text: No matter what happens, even when it looks like you're gonna lose, when no one else believes in you, when you don't believe in yourself... I will believe!
author: Rem

text: I won't leave you behind. I'll take you with me to the very end.
author: Shinei Nouzen

text: Some people are worth melting for.
author: Olaf

text: You and I are a team. Nothing is more important than our friendship.
author: Mike Wazowski

text: Group chat is my therapy.
author: Unknown

text: She's not my sister, but she is.
author: Unknown

text: Best friends finish each other's sentences.
author: Unknown

text: We don't need plans. Just each other.
author: Unknown

text: My best friend knows my whole mess.
author: Unknown

text: Friends who roast you love you most.
author: Unknown

text: We laugh at things nobody else gets.
author: Unknown

text: She held my hand through it all.
author: Unknown

text: Matching energy since day one.
author: Unknown

text: No one gets me like you do.
author: Unknown

text: We grew up, but we grew together.
author: Unknown

text: That one friend who feels like home.
author: Unknown

text: Three-hour phone calls fix everything.
author: Unknown

text: She showed up. That said everything.
author: Unknown

text: Best friends don't judge your 2am texts.
author: Unknown

text: We've been through it all and stayed.
author: Unknown

text: Ride or die isn't a phrase. It's a person.
author: Unknown

text: She's my favorite notification.
author: Unknown

text: Love is putting someone else's needs before yours.
author: Olaf

text: If you live to be 100, I hope I live to be 100 minus one day so I never have to live without you.
author: Winnie the Pooh

text: A day without a friend is like a pot without a single drop of honey left inside.
author: Winnie the Pooh

text: A hug is always the right size.
author: Winnie the Pooh

text: "We'll be Friends Forever, won't we, Pooh?" asked Piglet. "Even longer," Pooh answered.
author: Winnie the Pooh

text: "How do you spell 'love'?" — Piglet. "You don't spell it... you feel it." — Pooh.
author: Winnie the Pooh
